NOLI.FOOTER_DESCRIPTION: Thoughtful little things that make every day special. Handmade jewelry and scented candles, created with care.
NOLI.FOOTER_NOTE: For quiet moments, thoughtful gifts, and a little everyday joy.
NOLI.EYEBROW: WELCOME TO OUR LITTLE NOLI WORLD
NOLI.HERO_TEXT: Jewelry that tells your story and scented candles for moments that belong to you. Find your own little joy.
NOLI.HERO_NOTE: For you. For someone you love. From the heart.
NOLI.CANDLE_TAG: A SCENT OF WARMTH AND CALM
NOLI.RITUAL_TEXT: Light a candle. Make your favorite tea. Breathe. Sometimes these little moments are what make an ordinary day feel special.
NOLI.STORY_TEXT: Noli is a little spirit who notices what makes a day feel lovely. The first sip of warm tea. A candle glowing beside a book. A tiny detail chosen with someone in mind.
NOLI.STORY_TEXT_TWO: In his little world, making things takes time. Every bead, scent and finishing touch is a way to say: someone thought of you.
NOLI.CTA_TEXT: You don’t need a special occasion for a little kindness.
NOLI.NO_PRODUCTS: New little joys are on their way. Explore the whole collection.
NOLI.PRODUCT_ERROR: The collection is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
NOLI.SHOP_TEXT: Scented candles and jewelry. Thoughtfully made to brighten your day.
NOLI.CANDLE_ALT: Noli enjoys the warm glow of a scented candle
NOLI.JEWELRY_ALT: Noli makes a bracelet with pastel beads
NOLI.ADDED: A little joy is in your bag.
NOLI.CART_ERROR: Could not add to your bag. Please try again.
NOLI.BACK_TO_TOP: Fly to the top with Noli
NOLI.LOGIN_CAPTION: A gentle hello. A little joy.
NOLI.MOMENTS_TITLE: Step into the little Noli world
NOLI.MOMENTS_TEXT: A warm cup, a favourite scent and a little time for yourself. Let the day unfold gently.
NOLI.MOMENT_REST: A soft blanket and one more page. Nothing needs to hurry when you feel at home.
NOLI.MOMENT_CREATE: Bead by bead, Noli makes room for joy. A little of that care stays in every piece.
NOLI.MOMENT_LOVE: A little hug, just for you. You deserve the same kindness you give so freely.
NOLI.KINDNESS_ALT: Noli enjoys a quiet moment with a warm cup
NOLI.CURRENCY_NOTE: Currency depends on the payment method (PayPal/card: USD; other methods: selected currency).
NOLI.ABOUT_TITLE: Made slowly. Given from the heart.
NOLI.ABOUT_INTRO: Our story begins with little things that make you pause, smile and feel a little closer to yourself. Noli is here to remind us to keep making room for them.
NOLI.ABOUT_CANDLE_TITLE: A little light for your quiet moments
NOLI.ABOUT_CANDLE_TEXT: Noli loves the quiet rhythm of making. Choosing a scent, pouring carefully, waiting for each candle to settle. Nothing is rushed, because the little details are what make a gift feel personal.
NOLI.ABOUT_JEWELRY_TITLE: A little story in every bead
NOLI.ABOUT_JEWELRY_TEXT: Soft colours meet, beads find their place and a simple idea becomes something you can carry with you. Noli imagines the smile each piece might bring before it leaves his little table.
NOLI.ABOUT_LIFE_TITLE: There is beauty in taking your time
NOLI.ABOUT_LIFE_TEXT: To put on something you love. To light a candle before the evening begins. To do one small thing simply because it makes you happy. That is the Noli way, and there is a little room in it for you.
NOLI.MIRROR_ALT: Noli chooses a beaded bracelet in front of a mirror
NOLI.SELFCARE_ALT: Noli takes a gentle moment for himself
NOLI.MOMENT_SELFCARE: Noli begins the day with a little care. A quiet reminder that feeling good can start with one gentle moment.
NOLI.MOMENT_MIRROR: A favourite bracelet and a smile in the mirror. Sometimes a little detail is all it takes to feel like yourself.
NOLI.MOMENT_CANDLE: The candle is lit and the day can soften. Stay a little longer, breathe a little deeper and let this moment be yours.
